core_obligations: The author controls the first majority update through explicit binomial/Berry-Esseen estimates and dependence-sensitive covariance bounds, then proves uniform graph expansion/concentration statements that remain usable after later colors depend on the same graph. All original F(n,p,c), P1-P4 bounds and finite-n conditions are retained. The five-extra-vertices numerical instance, asymptotic version and sparse comparisons remain context, not separate counts; no numerical computation is rerun.
